## Findings refused

- Merging unit 10 into unit 9 (cleaner than a one-word unit): refused; the brief forbids changing `t`. The note was fixed instead.
- Reading čerbi as the title of all three (unit 11): left as drafted; the evidence is equal either way. Flagged in the note.
- Using “Daning” in `i` instead of “Beijing”: refused; the Han is 北京, and house practice follows the Han for Nanjing, Zhongdu.
- Renaming “Altan Qan” (Kitad / Jin): refused; the glossary and 249–252 use “Altan Qan”, and the Ming gloss 金 皇帝 is kept in the note.
- Unit 1 “bowed to the ground” (Ming 叩頭): left; adequate.
- `bümüi` = bü- + -mui, `-gde-` passive, `-ldü-` “together”: left; they fit the Ming and house usage.
- “Žürčedei” → Jürchedei, Alchi, Tolun: names in `i` kept as drafted per conventions.
